claims.summary: The V0.16.91 production edit exposed a transient current-attempt failure before the queued recovery save succeeded.
A current save failure receives a bounded confirmation window and is invalidated by a newer save attempt.
A permanent current-attempt failure still becomes visible after the five-second confirmation boundary.
Unit tests pin both transient suppression and permanent failure timing.
The quota-saturated Chromium proof edits a real course, observes past both timing boundaries, rejects failure frames, reloads, and restores the revision.
The patch changes persistence-status arbitration only and adds no model, compiler-quality, instructor, factual, accessibility, classroom, or paid-model claim.
